verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing provides narrow, domain-specific background automation: transaction rules that automatically approve or decline authorizations, configurable fallback logic when relayed authorisation times out, and event webhooks that let users trigger their own server-side workflows. There is no general-purpose automation or scheduled-job capability, and nothing aimed at AI agents. Missing for 10: a user-configurable automation/workflow builder beyond authorization rules, scheduled or recurring background jobs, agent-driven autonomous actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
